$comment: How a routine's trigger (hermes/plugins/jarvis-hud/routines.py _when) maps onto jarvis-core's
automation engine (aura/automation/triggers.py TRIGGER_PLATFORMS) when the routine is compiled
(T-0185). `core: null` means the trigger has no house-side equivalent and the routine stays on the
model path whatever it does. Times are the house's local time zone (jarvis-core's `time` trigger
and `time` condition use it, DST included), the same clock routines.py reads.
Read by the compile tests on both sides.

conditions.date: one-off routines (when.date) are not compiled: the house has no one-shot date trigger

arrive.note: the phone computes arrival (RoutineWatcher geofence) and sends this event on every edge (T-0332); a leave routine compiles only with away_min and a lock_if_idle house action (compiled.py), every other arrive/leave routine stays on the model path

car_connected.note: the car link is the phone's; the turn it opens is the model's

asked.note: a spoken phrase is a model turn by definition

message.note: reacting to a text needs judgement

pc_active.note: the desktop agent sees the session come back after idle_min away (T-0142)

pc_idle.note: the desktop agent sees the session idle for idle_min (T-0142)

pc_time.note: a time of day on the PC's own clock; not compiled, so the house never runs it (T-0142)
